_comment: Read by the app's fetchUpdateStatus() (lib/core/update_check.dart). ⚠️ THIS MUST MATCH WHAT THE STORES ACTUALLY SERVE, not what has been built or submitted. It said 211/3.2.35 on 2026-10-13 while both stores were still serving 210/3.2.34, so every user on the current build was told an update was waiting and tapped through to the version they already had. iOS does NOT save you: its Apple-lookup cross-check only RAISES a stale value, it never lowers one. Bump it when a release is LIVE and verified in the store, never when it is built or submitted. Android has no other source of truth, so a stale file is the only thing telling an Android user anything. Do NOT set minBuild unless you intend to hard-block older builds from opening.
